prs.title: [RN] Delete legacy event dispatching pipeline
prs.author: rubennorte
prs.body:
## Summary

The legacy events pipeline isn't currently in use, after the modern one (that lives in the RN repo) was enabled by default everywhere. This deletes the legacy pipeline from here to clean up the now unused code.

prs.title: [DevTools] Fix empty file names in stack frames under Hermes
prs.author: huntie
prs.body:
## Summary Hermes call sites implement `getFileName()` but not `getScriptNameOrSourceURL()`, so the backend records an empty file name for every frame on React Native. View source from the Components or Suspense inspector then has no URL to open. - Fall back to `getFileName()` when `getScriptNameOrSourceURL()` is missing. ## How did you test this change? ``` yarn test --build --project=devtools packages/react-devtools-shared/src/__tests__/utils-test.js ``` ✅ The new test feeds a call site with `getFileName()` and no `getScriptNameOrSourceURL()` through `parseStackTrace`; it fails without the fix (empty file name) and passes with it. Built the `react-devtools-core` backend and ran it in RNTester on an iOS simulator (Hermes), then used View source on a Suspense boundary in React Native DevTools. - Before: the backend sends `["Playground", "", 41, 46, …]`, and the frontend throws `Could not find resource for ` with nothing opened. - After: Sources opens the component file at the boundary's JSX, through source maps.
After: View source from the Suspense inspector

prs.title: [DevTools] Add Suspense tab entry point to react-devtools-fusebox
prs.author: huntie
prs.body:
## Summary React Native DevTools mounts each React DevTools tab as its own panel, through `initializeComponents` and `initializeProfiler`. The Suspense tab has no equivalent, so it cannot be shown there. - Add `initializeSuspense`, which renders the `suspense` tab the same way. ## How did you test this change? Built `react-devtools-fusebox`, vendored it into the React Native DevTools frontend with a Suspense panel that calls `initializeSuspense`, and opened it against RNTester on an iOS simulator with `react-devtools-core` 8.0.0 as the backend. The test screen nests named Suspense boundaries that resolve at different times, a `React.lazy` child, and one boundary that never resolves.
iPhone 18 ProSuspense panelBoundary selected
Temporary Suspense demo in Playground tab
✅ The tab renders on its own in a React Native DevTools panel: boundary map, reveal timeline, and the inspector showing what a boundary suspended on.

prs.author: SamChou19815

## Summary

Flow will soon require params in function type to be named to align with TS. This diff fixes the only violation in the React repo that will be synced to the RN repo.
